root.name: ウィリアムズ・カンパニーズ

relations.text: Transcoの最大の顧客で、同社の営業収益の約9%を占めた
relations.text_en: Duke Energy was Transco's largest customer at about 9 percent of its operating revenue

source.label: Williams Companies 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: For the year ended December 31, 2025, Transco’s largest customer was Duke Energy Corporation, which accounted for approximately 9 percent of its operating revenue

relations.text: NWPの最大の顧客で、同社の営業収益の約31%を占めた

source.label: Williams Companies 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: NWP’s largest customer was Puget Sound Energy, Inc., which accounted for approximately 31 percent of its operating revenue

companies.name: エクスパンド・エナジー

relations.text: 旧チェサピーク・エナジーで、ロイヤルティ訴訟で被告に挙げられた顧客の一社である
relations.text_en: Expand Energy, formerly Chesapeake, is among customers named in royalty lawsuits

source.label: Williams Companies 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Certain customers, including Expand Energy Corporation (formerly Chesapeake Energy Corporation or Chesapeake), have been named in various lawsuits alleging underpayment of royalties

companies.name: ブルー・レーサー・ミッドストリーム

relations.text: ユティカ層などの中流資産を持つ合弁会社に50%出資している
relations.text_en: Williams owns 50 percent of the Utica-focused midstream joint venture

source.label: Williams Companies 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Williams operates and owns a 50 percent interest in Blue Racer Midstream LLC (Blue Racer). Blue Racer is a joint venture to own, operate, develop, and acquire midstream assets in the Utica Shale and certain adjacent areas in the Marcellus Shale.

companies.name: ローレル・マウンテン・ミッドストリーム

relations.text: ペンシルベニア州西部の集ガス網を持つ合弁会社に69%出資している
relations.text_en: Williams owns 69 percent of the joint venture with a gathering system in western Pennsylvania

source.label: Williams Companies 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Williams operates and owns a 69 percent interest in a joint venture, Laurel Mountain Midstream, LLC (Laurel Mountain), which includes a 1,151-mile gathering system in western Pennsylvania

relations.text: LNG輸出施設を開発する同社の持分10%を2025年10月に取得した
relations.text_en: Williams acquired a 10 percent equity-method investment in Louisiana LNG in October 2025

source.label: Williams Companies 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: In October 2025, Williams closed on various agreements with the same counterparty to acquire a 10 percent equity-method investment in Louisiana LNG LLC (Louisiana LNG), which is developing a fully permitted LNG export facility

companies.name: コージェントリックス共同投資ファンド
companies.sub: ガス火力投資ファンド

relations.text: 少数持分を取得しており、同ファンドは11のガス火力発電所に持分を持つ
relations.text_en: Williams bought a minority interest, with interests in 11 gas power plants

source.label: Williams Companies 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: In March 2025, Williams purchased a minority interest in Cogentrix Co-Investment Fund, LP (Cogentrix) which is accounted for as an equity-method investment within the Gas & NGL Marketing Services segment. Cogentrix owns interests in 11 natural gas power plants
